scope.current_boundary: Derive and use straight-line constant-acceleration equations (suvat) from definitions of velocity and acceleration. Select and rearrange appropriate equations for single-stage and multi-stage problems, including braking and reverse motion under constant acceleration, and bodies falling in a uniform gravitational field without air resistance.

scope.next_boundary_checked: Falling objects and Upward motion and measuring g: vertical motion under gravity and experimental determination of g.
